clinical_intent: I am managing a 48-year-old male with a 5 cm prostate cancer (Gleason 4+4, Stage T3a, PSA 22) who has a history of severe opioid use disorder (in sustained remission for 3 years on buprenorphine/naloxone). He has chronic pain from degenerative disc disease requiring ongoing opioid management. He has well-controlled hepatitis C from his prior IV drug use (SVR achieved). He has depression treated with venlafaxine. He wants definitive treatment. Given his substance abuse history and ongoing opioid use, should I recommend LDR brachytherapy? How does his buprenorphine/naloxone affect treatment? Should I adjust his pain management during brachytherapy? What are the implications for treatment compliance?
